about.name: Dra. Júlia Saggiomo
about.subtitle: Plastic surgery with purpose, technique and humanity
about.bio1: Dra. Júlia Saggiomo is a medical specialist in Plastic Surgery, with solid academic training focused on natural, safe and personalized results for each patient.
about.bio2: With extensive experience in facial and body procedures, Dra. Júlia combines surgical excellence with a keen eye for individual expectations and needs of each patient.
about.bio3: Her commitment is to offer humanized and transparent care, where every decision is made together with the patient, prioritizing safety, well-being and results that respect natural harmony.
about.indicator2Label: Blepharoplasty, Lipo, Abdominoplasty, Mammoplasty, Laser, Photobiomodulation
about.quote: I believe that true beauty lies in the harmony and confidence that each patient achieves when feeling good about themselves.
